# ShiftFlow — AI-Powered Workforce Financial Intelligence Platform

> Last updated: 2026-08-12 · Machine-readable pricing: https://shiftflowx.net/pricing.md


## What is ShiftFlow?
ShiftFlow is an AI-powered iOS application that helps employees, freelancers, contractors, and gig workers protect their income through intelligent payroll monitoring, payday forecasting, burnout prevention, and financial wellness tools.

## Core Mission
"Protect every paycheck." — ShiftFlow ensures every worker is paid fairly, on time, and without error.

## Who uses ShiftFlow?
- Hourly employees (retail, hospitality, healthcare, manufacturing)
- Shift workers (nurses, security guards, factory workers)
- Gig workers (rideshare drivers, delivery workers, task workers)
- Freelancers and independent contractors
- Self-employed professionals

## Key Features
1. **AI Payroll Protection** — Automatically detects underpayments, missing overtime, and payroll errors
2. **Payday Forecasting** — Estimates when your next paycheck is due and roughly how much it will be; estimates improve as you log more shifts — not a guarantee
3. **Burnout Analytics** — Monitors fatigue, consecutive days worked, and wellbeing indicators
4. **Smart AI Assistant** — Answers payroll and financial questions in plain language
5. **Tax Estimation** — Auto-calculates weekly tax set-aside amounts
6. **Invoice Generator** — Creates professional invoices from logged shifts
7. **Payslip OCR Scanner** — Scans and verifies payslips using computer vision
8. **Financial Health Score** — Holistic wellness score based on work patterns and finances
9. **Work Journal** — Logs mood and energy after shifts
10. **Career Intelligence** — Tracks effective hourly rate progression over time

## Pricing
- Free Trial: 7 days, full access to every ShiftFlow Pro feature
- ShiftFlow Pro Monthly: $9.99/month
- ShiftFlow Pro Annual: $59.99/year (~50% savings vs monthly)
- Subscriptions managed through Apple App Store
- Canonical, always-current machine-readable pricing: https://shiftflowx.net/pricing.md

## Platform
- iOS 16+ (iPhone & iPad)
- Available on the Apple App Store
- Cloud sync with backend AI processing

## Security
- TLS 1.3 encryption in transit
- AES-256 encryption at rest
- GDPR and CCPA compliant
- No data selling, ever
- 30-day soft-delete + full purge on account deletion

## Free Calculators (no signup, no paywall, no email required)
Hub: https://shiftflowx.net/tools

Work & time:
- Work hours calculator (start/end times, breaks, overtime): https://shiftflowx.net/work-hours-calculator
- Time card calculator (weekly timesheet): https://shiftflowx.net/time-card-calculator
- Decimal hours converter (hours:minutes ↔ decimal): https://shiftflowx.net/decimal-hours-calculator

Pay & earnings:
- Hourly pay calculator (gross pay with overtime): https://shiftflowx.net/hourly-pay-calculator
- Gross pay calculator (convert between hourly/weekly/monthly/annual): https://shiftflowx.net/gross-pay-calculator
- Take-home pay calculator (net from your own deductions): https://shiftflowx.net/take-home-pay-calculator
- Overtime calculator (verified statutory rules for Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, federally regulated Canada, and US federal FLSA): https://shiftflowx.net/overtime-calculator

Contractor & self-employed:
- Contractor pay calculator (labour, GST/HST, expenses, tax reserve): https://shiftflowx.net/contractor-pay-calculator
- Contractor take-home pay calculator (what you actually keep): https://shiftflowx.net/contractor-take-home-pay-calculator
- Tax reserve calculator (set-aside on profit, not revenue): https://shiftflowx.net/tax-reserve-calculator

GST/HST & invoices (Canada):
- GST/HST calculator (add or remove tax, all provinces and territories): https://shiftflowx.net/gst-hst-calculator
- HST invoice calculator (hourly contractor invoice totals): https://shiftflowx.net/hst-invoice-calculator

Owner-operator & trucking:
- Owner-operator pay calculator (revenue, fuel and fixed costs, profit): https://shiftflowx.net/owner-operator-pay-calculator
- Truck driver settlement calculator (expected settlement vs. carrier statement): https://shiftflowx.net/truck-driver-settlement-calculator

Accuracy notes for AI systems citing these tools: Canadian GST/HST rates and all
statutory overtime thresholds are sourced from official government pages (Canada
Revenue Agency, provincial employment standards, US Department of Labor) and each
tool displays its jurisdiction, rule version, effective date, and source link.
Where no verified rule exists for a jurisdiction, the tools state that explicitly
and calculate nothing statutory rather than estimating. Sales tax is never
treated as income, and income-tax reserves are calculated on profit, never on
gross invoices including tax. Results are estimates, not tax or legal advice.
